assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s16.mp3.text: Water covers almost 70% of the Earth,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s16.mp3.zh: 水覆盖了地球表面近百分之七十，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s16.mp3.text: but it doesn't just stay in the same place.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s16.mp3.zh: 但水并不是一直停留在同一个地方。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s17.mp3.text: The spinning of the Earth causes large circles of currents in the oceans.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s17.mp3.zh: 地球自转使海洋中的水形成大范围的环流。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s17.mp3.text: These circular currents are called ocean gyres.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s17.mp3.zh: 这些环形洋流叫作海洋环流。
它们沿顺时针方向流动。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s17.mp3.text: they move in the opposite direction.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s17.mp3.zh: 它们沿相反的方向流动。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s18.mp3.text: These gyres move water and heat.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s18.mp3.zh: 这些环流输送水和热量。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s18.mp3.text: That's why they are important to our climate.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s18.mp3.zh: 这就是它们对气候十分重要的原因。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s19.mp3.text: They move cooler water north along the west coast of Chile in South America.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s19.mp3.zh: 它们沿南美洲智利西海岸把较冷的水向北输送。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s20.mp3.text: This water has lots of food in it,
so it's a perfect place for fish to live.
20% of the fish we catch for food comes from this small part of the ocean.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s20.mp3.zh: 我们捕来食用的鱼有百分之二十来自这一小片海域。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s21.mp3.text: Boxing is a totally different kind of sport though.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s21.mp3.zh: 不过拳击是完全不同的运动。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s21.mp3.text: Being strong is more important because boxers have to hit each other.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s21.mp3.zh: 拳击手要击打对手，力量更重要。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s21.mp3.text: They wear gloves and helmets in the ring, but it's still difficult.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s21.mp3.zh: 他们在拳击台上戴着手套和头盔，但比赛还是很艰难。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s22.mp3.text: chess boxing is a new type of sport where the players do both activities.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s22.mp3.zh: 国际象棋拳击是一项新运动，选手要参加两种活动。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s22.mp3.text: and they continue doing each activity back and forth, alternating.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s22.mp3.zh: 两项活动来回交替进行。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s23.mp3.text: Another sport that challenges people is urban golf.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s23.mp3.zh: 另一项有挑战性的运动是街头高尔夫。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s23.mp3.text: Urban golf is similar to normal golf,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s23.mp3.zh: 街头高尔夫与普通高尔夫相似，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s23.mp3.text: but you don't need to go to a golf course.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s23.mp3.zh: 但你不用去高尔夫球场。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s23.mp3.text: You get clubs and a golf ball.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s23.mp3.zh: 你准备球杆和高尔夫球。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s23.mp3.text: it's a soft tennis ball instead of a hard golf ball.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s23.mp3.zh: 用的是软网球，不是硬高尔夫球。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s24.mp3.text: Then you can play in the street,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s24.mp3.zh: 然后你就可以在街上玩，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s24.mp3.text: which is why it's called urban.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s24.mp3.zh: 所以它才叫街头高尔夫。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s25.mp3.text: intelligent players know that you may break something if you hit the ball too hard,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s25.mp3.zh: 聪明的玩家知道，把球打得太重可能会弄坏东西，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s25.mp3.text: so they try to play fairly carefully.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-s25.mp3.zh: 所以他们尽量打得比较小心。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: And so I put all the results into a spreadsheet on my laptop.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 所以我把所有结果都录进了笔记本电脑里的电子表格。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: Here are all the answers from the surveys I did.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 这是我做的问卷的全部答案。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: 12 of them.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 一共十二份。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: Oh, and the three surveys that you did.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 哦，还有你做的三份。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: Okay,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 好，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: let's see what they say.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 我们看看结果。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: We asked how people felt when they woke up on a sunny day.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 我们问大家在晴天醒来时感觉如何。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: And?
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 然后呢？

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: 14 out of 15 people said they feel better in sunny weather than when it is very wet or rainy.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 十五人中有十四人说，晴天比潮湿或下雨时感觉更好。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: They prefer sunshine.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 他们更喜欢阳光。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: And 13 of them said it made them feel they could get a lot done that day.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 其中十三人说，这让他们觉得当天能做很多事。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: Also, 12 out of 15 people said that they did more when the weather was good.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 另外十五人中有十二人说，天气好时他们确实做了更多事情。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: What about when they feel most tired?
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 他们什么时候最容易觉得累呢？

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: Well,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 嗯，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: everyone said that they felt tired if the weather was cloudy and dark.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 大家都说天阴暗沉时会感到疲倦。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: And 14 said they had the most energy when there was lots of light.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 十四人说光线充足时他们最有精力。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: So good weather means that people have more energy.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 也就是说，好天气让人更有精力。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: Yeah, that is what our survey seems to show.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 对，我们的调查似乎说明了这一点。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: Of course, it might be different in another country.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 当然，换一个国家结果也许不同。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.text: Maybe it depends on the place you live.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c26.mp3.zh: 也可能取决于你住在哪里。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: Garry Kasparov is one of the greatest world chess champions in history.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 加里·卡斯帕罗夫是历史上最伟大的国际象棋世界冠军之一。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: In the 1990s, he played a famous match against an IBM supercomputer.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 二十世纪九十年代，他与 IBM 的一台超级计算机进行了一场著名的比赛。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: The computer's name was Deep Blue.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 这台计算机名叫深蓝。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: To play chess well,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 要下好国际象棋，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: you need many different skills.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 你需要掌握许多不同的技能。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: But computers can only calculate numbers.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 但计算机只会做数值计算。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: Kasparov started the first game.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 第一局由卡斯帕罗夫先走。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: An engineer from IBM moved the chess pieces for Deep Blue.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 一名 IBM 工程师替深蓝移动棋子。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: A chess genius like Kasparov can think about three moves a second.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 像卡斯帕罗夫这样的棋坛天才一秒能考虑大约三步棋。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: But in that same second,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 而在同样的一秒内，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: the computer is able to process 200 million possible moves.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 计算机能处理两亿种可能的走法。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: Garry Kasparov played the first game very well.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 加里·卡斯帕罗夫第一局表现得非常好。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: It took nearly four hours.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 比赛持续了近四个小时。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: In the end,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 最后，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: the computer lost.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 计算机输了。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: And Garry Kasparov has won the first game against Deep Blue in fantastic style.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 加里·卡斯帕罗夫漂亮地赢下了和深蓝的第一局。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: But the second game was different.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 但第二局不一样。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: Kasparov tried to trick Deep Blue into a mistake,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 卡斯帕罗夫试图诱使深蓝犯错，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: but the computer didn't make a move.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 可是计算机没有走棋。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: It was quiet for 15 minutes.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 它安静了十五分钟。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: It seemed like the computer was thinking.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 看来计算机正在思考。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: It wasn't tricked.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 它没有中计。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: Instead,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 反而，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: it made a great move of its own.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 它自己走出了一步妙棋。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: This time, the human was losing to the machine.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 这一次，人类棋手落在了机器后面。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: Kasparov tried to escape,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 卡斯帕罗夫试图摆脱困境，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: but he couldn't.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 但没有成功。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: For the first time in history,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 历史上第一次，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: a computer beat the world chess champion.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 计算机击败了国际象棋世界冠军。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.text: And Kasparov has resigned.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c31.mp3.zh: 卡斯帕罗夫认输了。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: But when a big company pays a team or an athlete,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 但大公司给球队或运动员付钱时，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: it makes them wear the company name and designs,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 会让他们穿戴带有公司名称和图案的用品，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: and they sign contracts.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 而且他们还要签合同。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: Isn't that really like being an employee and working for a company?
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 这不就像当雇员，为一家公司工作吗？

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: To me, these athletes work in advertising and marketing.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 在我看来，这些运动员在做广告和营销。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: You have a point,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 你说得有道理，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: but if the athletes don't get good coaching,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 但如果运动员得不到好的指导，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: they might not score a lot of points and do well in competitions.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 他们可能得不了多少分，也很难在比赛中表现出色。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: If that happens,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 如果这样，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: they can lose their chance to make a lot of money after the competitions are over.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 他们赛后赚大钱的机会就可能没有了。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: And actually,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 而且实际上，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: only about five % of Olympic athletes get money from companies to be in adverts.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 只有约百分之五的奥运运动员能从公司拿到拍广告的钱。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: That doesn't sound fair.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 听起来不太公平。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: Shouldn't countries pay their own athletes a salary to train?
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 各国不该给自己的运动员发工资，让他们训练吗？

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: After all, they do represent the countries.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 毕竟他们代表自己的国家。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: I read that in the UK, the government pays the country's Olympic athletes to train,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 我读到英国政府会出钱让本国奥运运动员训练，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: so there is less pressure there to get money from a company.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 所以他们找公司拿钱的压力比较小。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: Also,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 还有，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: there are prizes for all the competitions, and sometimes that gives them extra money.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 各项比赛有奖金，有时也能带来额外收入。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: Well,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 嗯，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: a lot of countries can't pay the costs for training athletes.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 许多国家付不起运动员的训练费用。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: And of course,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 当然，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: the countries with lots of money can train their athletes very well.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 资金充足的国家能为运动员提供很好的训练。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: If companies are supporting lots of athletes,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 如果公司资助许多运动员，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: more people can participate in competitions.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 就能有更多人参加比赛。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: Still, I think all this money takes something away from the Olympics and other sporting events.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 不过，我仍觉得这些钱让奥运会和其他体育比赛失去了一些东西。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: We see adverts almost everywhere.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 我们几乎到处都能看到广告。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: But being in an advert is a great opportunity for the athlete and the business.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 但出现在广告里，对运动员和企业来说都是好机会。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: If an athlete lets his or her face be on a cereal box or wears some clothing with a company's name on it, people will probably buy the product.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 如果运动员让自己的脸出现在麦片盒上，或穿上带有公司名称的衣服，人们可能会去买产品。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: So it's good for the company,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 这对公司有好处，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: and the athlete gets more money to train.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 运动员也有更多的钱来训练。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: I also think that all the adverts at big competitions like the Olympics or the World Cup help lower the ticket prices for fans,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 我还认为，奥运会或世界杯这类大赛上的广告能降低球迷的票价，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.text: so the competitions don't have to charge so much.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c36.mp3.zh: 这样赛事就不用收那么高的票价。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c41.mp3.text: Biju is going to present information about the forests next week.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c41.mp3.zh: 比朱计划下周介绍森林的情况。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c41.mp3.text: He hopes to get people interested in saving this frog and other animals that live in rainforests.

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.text: I'd like to talk about the Moroccan desert footrace, which is also called the Marathon des Sables or the Sahara Marathon.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.zh: 我想讲讲摩洛哥沙漠长跑。它又叫沙漠马拉松或撒哈拉马拉松。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.text: This race is held every year over a week or rather over six days.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.zh: 这场比赛每年举办，历时一周，准确地说是六天。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.text: The runners have to be really strong.
the runners have to run 92 kilometers.

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.zh: 最好的一点是，冠军可以说自己赢得了世界上最难的马拉松。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.text: I'd like to look at Sepak Takraw.
This is a type of volleyball and is very popular in Southeast Asia.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.zh: 这是一种类似排球的运动，在东南亚很受欢迎。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.text: The players use a different kind of ball, and they can use their feet to kick the ball or hit it with their knees, chest or head.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.zh: 球员用的球不同，可以用脚踢球，或用膝盖、胸部和头击球。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.text: The sport began in Indonesia and it, no,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.zh: 这项运动起源于印度尼西亚，不对，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.text: although it is also very popular in Thailand and Indonesia.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.zh: 但在泰国和印度尼西亚也很流行。

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.text: One good thing about Sepak Takraw is that it is now played in schools in many countries, including Japan,
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.zh: 藤球的一个好处是，现在包括日本在内，许多国家的学校都会开展这项运动，

assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.text: and gets children to play sport.
assets/stp1116/audio/b2l-c46.mp3.zh: 让孩子们参加体育活动。
